# ClaimGraph PI

ClaimGraph PI is an explainable pre-payment healthcare claims investigation and provider network intelligence platform.

## Public documentation

- /about: methodology, data boundaries, and model limitations
- /privacy: privacy policy
- /terms: terms of service
- /support: support and bug-report guidance
- https://github.com/SomeshZanwar/ClaimGraph-PI: source repository and technical documentation

## Important boundaries

- Public/demo data is synthetic CMS DE-SynPUF data.
- The product is investigation support, not automated claim adjudication.
- Anomaly scores are not fraud probabilities.
- Graph connectivity is not proof of fraud or misconduct.
- Do not submit real protected health information to the public demonstration.
